req.title: Delete unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when DELETE targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-014 requires DELETE /tasks/{task_id} to return HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a known-existing task is deleted with 204, (2) a negative/primary case confirming a non-existent task_id returns exactly 404 with the correct detail message, (3) a boundary case using task_id=21 (one above the highest seeded id=20) to confirm 404, (4) a boundary case using task_id=0 (below the minimum valid id) to confirm 404, and (5) a state-transition case confirming that deleting an already-deleted task returns 404 on the second call. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite in-memory database seeded with the specified fixture rows, ensuring determinism and idempotency.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204
preconditions: Database contains task with id=1 (Read chapter 5, completed=true)
TestClient is initialised against the in-process FastAPI app with a fresh in-memory DB
trace: R-TASK-014 — positive path: existing id must succeed with 204, not 404
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db = TestingSession()
db.add(models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', description='desc', completed=True))
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

from app.database import get_db
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204():
    r = client.delete('/tasks/1')
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b''

test_delete_existing_task_returns_204()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
